exposure: Intraoperative abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (IAABO) during cesarean section
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 140 patients with pernicious placenta previa (PPP) and placenta accreta undergoing cesarean section at a single hospital.
finding: Intraoperative abdominal aortic balloon occlusion during cesarean sections significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss, blood transfusion volume, hysterectomy rate, postoperative pain, and complications, while increasing patient satisfaction and reducing NICU admission rates in patients with pernicious placenta previa.
mod_finding: The study evaluated an intervention during cesarean section for high-risk placenta previa, finding it effective in reducing bleeding and complications associated with this mode of birth.
